messages:
danielle: Heads up — we need to lock streaming semantics for chat/completions this week. Customer asks are stacking up; main decisions: SSE vs WS, delta encoding shape (text vs structured JSON), resume/fallback, and finish_reason taxonomy. Quick sync?

ravi: +1. From enterprise pilots: resume support is number one (mobile reconnections). They also want structured deltas for easier client-side rendering, and websockets for multiplexing multiple chats over one connection.

maya: Runtime POV: SSE is way simpler to operate (fits existing HTTP LB infra). Websockets give lower per-message overhead and true bidirectional, but require connection pins / sticky routing or a proxy layer. Implementation complexity/time: SSE << WS.

alex: SDK note — clients prefer small JSON delta events rather than raw text diffs. Suggest shape like `{"event":"delta", "role":"assistant", "content":"..."}`. Also need clear `finish_reason` values so apps can differentiate truncated outputs vs normal stops vs tool invocations.

zhou: Research: models sometimes emit partial tokens (mid-word) when streaming. We should define what constitutes a final chunk: eos token emitted or model signals final. Otherwise richness of deltas will confuse UIs that assume word boundaries.

danielle: Proposed MVP: default to SSE with newline-delimited JSON events; include a `resume_token` on each event usable by clients to attempt reconnection + replay. Define `finish_reason` enum: `stop`, `length`, `tool_call`, `error`, `incomplete`. Defer WS + multiplexing to v2. Thoughts? :thinking:

ravi: :+1: Enterprise customers will accept SSE if resume semantics are robust. Two asks: (1) strong ordering guarantee when resuming (no duplicate/missing tokens), (2) config for how far back server can replay (we can't keep full prefixes forever).

maya: We can implement `resume_window` (config per deployment) — server stores last N tokens / events. Reconnect will use `Last-Event-ID` or `resume_token` to request a delta tail. Risk: KV cache mismatch if we roll out a new model/version mid-session. Need fallback plan (reject resume + instruct client to fetch full completion).

alex: For SDKs I'll add `onDelta(delta)` and `onResume({ok, reason})` hooks, plus default fallback to polling a non-stream completion endpoint if resume fails. Need to sync handler names across JS/Swift/Kotlin.

zhou: Suggest we define a small structured-delta schema to cover common cases: `event_type` (delta|function_call_begin|function_call_arg|function_call_end|final), `seq` (monotonic int), `resume_token`, and `payload` (string or object). Keep backward compat by allowing a `text` field for simple clients. Example event:```{
  "event_type": "delta",
  "seq": 124,
  "resume_token": "r-xyz",
  "payload": {"content": "hello"}
}```

ravi: Customer edge: some corporate proxies aggressively buffer SSE and strip chunking unless we flush frequently. We'll need heartbeat events and doc guidance to customers: set `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, disable buffering on proxies where possible.

danielle: Draft launch criteria (v0):
- protocol doc with examples (SSE NDJSON + structured-delta schema)
- hosted API pilot with resume + finish_reason exposed
- SDK primitives in JS + mobile (basic handlers)
- resume test matrix (flaky nets, reconnect sequences)
- evals to validate `finish_reason` mapping across models
- security & CORS review

If all green, we ship SSE-based streaming as GA; websocket/multiplex as a separate initiative.

maya: Implementation actionables: prototype resume token mechanism and perf impact (memory + CPU) in a sandbox, evaluate replay latency. I'll estimate effort: prototype (2w), QA + tests (1w), docs (1w).

alex: SDK actionables: draft handler API + mobile example (Android + iOS integration notes). ETA: 2w for initial PR, 1w for cross-language sync.

zhou: I'll write the structured-delta schema and a small compat guide for text-only clients. Also run small evals to ensure `finish_reason` is consistent across our model catalog.

ravi: I'll enumerate 3 pilot customers and coordinate with sales to get acceptance criteria. Also will capture proxy/enterprise constraints we've seen.

danielle: OK — owners noted. I'll own the PRD and the launch checklist. Please ping me by EOD Friday with first drafts. deploy-bot: reminder: infra sync tomorrow 10:30 (noted). :rocket:
